audit_scope.actual_file: Complete current two-unit file read in one untruncated tool output; compared the exact conditional nonsplit crown proposition and the complete final coherent-sector input at SHA705b9db44b90b7aefffc731ea54600605eb5a63a11095c6113e670ccea0dd4a6.
mathematics: The full obstruction coefficient is the H-module F_q^*(chi), not a purported central subgroup of the full semilinear group. The already proved group-H2 bound counts complete coefficient classes, including Kummer data; no wild-normal-kernel H2 inflation is used.
The composite tame-cover identities E*v=t*a and nu=f/a give nu*E*v=t*f exactly. Genus and normal degree are measured over the original resolution.

A realized rank-r object makes the geometric period m divide r and n. The coherent full-root extension and single-sector Morita lattice keep the actual gerbe and deck cocycle while removing all h=n/m layer and sector-choice costs.

With J=c*E*m and b=ceil(c1*nu*v*m*s^2), the padded number of variables is O(nu*E*v*r^2). Weighted Bezout yields (w+1)*K^b*((K*E*m)^J/J!)^b, hence exp(O(nu*E*v*r^2)); ceilings, the residual block and the component prefactor are absorbed uniformly.

The presentation uses only nu one-p-step phases. Its final deck map is k-linear on coordinate variables. The a-fold iteration belongs only to the exact skew-unit/fixed-frame comparison, and its actual gerbe coherence supplies the descent identity; no hidden degree-a equation or p^nu coordinate operation is added.

Twisted finite frames on the fixed coefficient gerbe surject onto projective semilinear classes with that obstruction. Multiple twisted lifts can map to one projective class, so the direction of the upper bound is correct. Finite-presentation unit-Isom and all-Artinian specified lifting give open-and-closed class fibres, not merely tangent rigidity.
Multiplying by q^(c_R*t) and using nu*E*v=t*f gives q^(A_R*t*r^2), uniformly in all listed indices. The r=1 and q=2 edge cases are handled.

The actual nonsplit crown reduction applies: graph-kernel covers and field characters are subquotients of the fixed tame outer cover. Killing the graph costs at most b0, extension and inner-versus-projective conjugacy cost at most q^(b0*r^2), and the stated c_R and LMT generator bound follow. The faithful embedding, bounded graph quotient and order comparison remain explicit hypotheses.
